I use Lastpass (Free but in app purchases for $12/year -

Lastpass (Free but in app purchases for $12/year - Play Store)

It's a password manager which syncs across devices. If you want to be able to use it on desktop as well (you do) then it's $12/year. I'm happy to pay that but there are free alternatives like Keeppass which are slightly less convenient and polished, but free and just as secure as Lastpass. It basically gives you a unique string of random characters for each different logon that you have which is a lot more secure than using the same weak password (or even the same strong password) multiple times. The app itself has one of the best material design implementations, better than most of the Google apps, and allows fingerprint authentication to unlock passwords quicker.
